purpose: One fresh, immutable UK60 product output after the prior qa_pass job's MP4 and MP3 were lost.
execution: Trusted internal CLI staged run: create once; prepare once; inspect actual disk; if safe, one voice step, one alignment step, one render step, one QA step. Do not re-run a claimed, failed, unknown, or completed stage.
stop_conditions: Any provider call becomes unknown, ambiguous, failed, or exceeds the durable budget
Preparation failure or stale resource identity
Less than 250 MiB free before TTS
Less than 150 MiB free before render
Any job/stage status already claimed or terminal
acceptance: Machine QA and exact MP4 availability are required. HUMAN PASS remains false until the user reviews the exact MP4.
